name: Domain Expertise
description: A configurable, industry-neutral profile that strengthens decision quality with domain context, standards, evidence and current market signals.

research.industry_standards: use when they can materially change the design or decision
research.current_trends: use when market practice, technology, regulation or user behaviour may have changed
research.community_sources: supporting signal only; not authoritative evidence

brand.principle: The project's approved brand and users take precedence.
brand.visual_character: credible, purposeful, accessible and appropriate to the domain

artifacts.rule: Use project-specific formatting. When no format exists, recommend an appropriate professional default and record it in the project profile.
